Building and bases

PvE teammate can't open chests? Check cupboard authorization

On PvE servers, chests inside a protected building can be opened only by the Tool Cupboard owner and authorized players. If a teammate can enter but cannot open chests, check their authorization.

This protection depends on cupboard coverage. Chests outside that area do not have the same protection; choosing PvE does not make storage safe everywhere.
